selection.method: First 25 matching records in pinned source document-array order; IDs frozen explicitly. Convenience sample, not representative or a tablet series.

query_method: Case-sensitive literal Unicode substring search; no normalization, tokenization, lemma or linguistic word segmentation.
marker_policy: Conservative whole-record screen of the transcription surface only. Presence/absence of these characters is not an epigraphic certainty judgment. Other notation may remain unscreened.
